Existing tools make you choose. Software KVMs (Synergy, Deskflow, Mouse Without Borders) share your mouse and keyboard but carry no video. Second-screen apps (Duet, spacedesk, Luna) turn a spare machine into a monitor but share no input. EasySwitch does both: slide your cursor across computers, type and paste anywhere, drag files, and extend your desktop onto the machine next to you. Encryption is free for everyone, not an upsell.
